difficulty_reason: Existence of the right adjoint RQ_X to the inclusion D_QCoh -> D for qcqs X: uses the adjoint-existence criterion (triangles E' -> E -> K with E' in D_QCoh and Hom(M, K) = 0 for all M in D_QCoh), reduces along the Mayer-Vietoris triangle by the prepare-adjoint lemma to the case E = Rj_*L, and constructs the required triangle on U from the iff-version of the criterion: L' -> L -> Q with the orthogonality on U, pushes forward (Rj_*L' in D_QCoh by the quasi-coherence lemma), and computes Hom(M, Rj_*Q) = Hom(Lj^*M, Q) = 0 by adjunction and pullback quasi-coherence.
